lastText: The Case Is ClosedTwo at the FallsNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 41REICHENBACH TRAGEDY: THE PROFESSOR DEAD, THE DETECTIVE SAFE. COLONEL MORAN FLEESThe guides arrive with their lanterns just after dark, and find two Englishmen sitting on a wet rock with a revolver between them. The Professor's body is found two days later at the foot of the Falls. Colonel Moran has been taken at Interlaken, in a railway carriage, with an air-gun in a violin case. In Baker Street, a month afterwards, the lamp is lit and the fire is kept, and the old armchair across the hearth is occupied again. Watson writes it all down, in his own way, and gives it to a magazine. You tell him that it is too romantic. He tells you that you are an ungrateful man. It is, you both agree, a perfectly satisfactory way to end an argument. In the years that follow, the world remembers a man who kept his friends about him, and who was kinder than he allowed.
